scope: Strict epistemic separation between analyst hypotheses (mandatory Author and Rationale, IsSourceEvidence=false, RecordKind=analyst_hypothesis) and SealStore/EventIndexStore observed facts with anti-promotion guards and restart tamper defense

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Passed all Go engine and integration test suites (cmd/breachatlas and tests including TestC20FixturesAndProvenance, TestC20HypothesisAuthorRationaleAndSeparation, TestC20NegativePrerequisitesMalformedAndProviders, TestC20RestartRecoveryAndTamperDefense, and TestC20ConcurrentFindingsAndLedgerRace).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: RecordHypothesis in FindingStore requires non-empty bounded Author (ErrMissingAuthor), Rationale (ErrMissingRationale), and Statement (ErrInvalidHypothesis), and enforces RecordKind=analyst_hypothesis and IsSourceEvidence=false.

BuildEpistemicLedger projects ObservedFacts strictly from verified EventIndexStore entries and SealStore sealed blobs and isolates AnalystHypotheses in a separate collection even when UILabel carries strings such as source_evidence.
Explicit promotion flags (ClaimSourceEvidence=true, ClaimRecordKind=observed_fact) and PromoteHypothesisToEvidence fail closed with ErrPromotionForbidden.

Missing SealStore or supporting evidence/event prerequisites reject with ErrMissingPrerequisite; non-local providers reject with ErrUnavailableProvider; unsupported versions, path traversal, and lock contention fail closed.

Crash recovery cleans orphan staging files, preserves idempotent replay and conflict detection across restarts, rejects on-disk tampering that flips is_source_evidence on reopen, and leaves sealed source bytes unmodified.

observed_limitations: Web UI presentation of case evidence verification and custody integrity (C21) is deferred to its planned task.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/findings/notes.go, tests/facts_test.go, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C20, and docs/evidence/C20.json. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
